scene.actor: One person rests in a chair with a book after the workweek.
beats: The workweek ends
Sunday arrives
The person rests
scene.ending: Sunday is a day of rest at the end of the week.

review.reason: 一个 week（星期）走完，Sunday（星期日）正是歇下来的一天。

cards.sentence: school（学校）和它安静的 surroundings（环境）让人心里很平静。

scene.actor: No people: a small school building sits among trees and an open garden.
beats: The school sits in the landscape
Trees and garden surround it
The peaceful surroundings are clear
scene.ending: A school sits in peaceful surroundings.

review.reason: school（学校）四周的草木与街巷，合起来就是它的 surroundings（环境）。

cards.sentence: friend（朋友）遭遇不幸后，她开始 sympathise（同情）对方。

scene.actor: Exactly two friends sit together as one comforts the other after a loss.
beats: One friend shares sad news
The other listens with care
She begins to sympathise
scene.ending: One friend sympathises with another after a loss.

review.reason: friend（朋友）遇到难处，她心里跟着难受，sympathise（同情）就是这份体谅。

cards.sentence: 一艘 tanker（油轮）载着石油，横渡了 sea（海洋）。

scene.actor: No people: one large tanker carries oil across the water.
beats: The tanker loads its cargo
It travels across the sea
The oil tanker moves steadily forward
scene.ending: An oil tanker carries cargo across the sea.

review.reason: 装大宗液货横渡 sea（海洋）的大船就是 tanker（油轮）。

cards.sentence: Thanksgiving（感恩节）这天，family（家）里的人围坐分享一顿饭。

scene.setting: A warm dining room on Thanksgiving
scene.actor: Exactly two family members share a simple holiday meal at a table.
beats: The family gathers
They share a meal
They celebrate Thanksgiving together
scene.ending: A family shares a meal at Thanksgiving.

review.reason: Thanksgiving（感恩节）最看重的就是 family（家）聚在一起吃饭感恩。

cards.sentence: 哨子响过三声，队伍在操场上站成一条线，旗帜举起来时他指着前排说，then 就是 them，一个都不许少。

review.reason: them 与 then 同尾，那时他们就是。

cards.sentence: thigh（大腿）是 leg（腿）最粗的那一段，从髋连到膝。

scene.actor: One teacher points to the upper leg on a simple unlabelled body model.
beats: The leg is shown
The upper section is identified
The thigh is located above the knee
scene.ending: The thigh is the upper part of the leg.

review.reason: 从髋到膝那一段就是 thigh（大腿），是 leg（腿）最粗的上半截。

cards.sentence: 她伸手去摘 rose（玫瑰），被茎上的 thorn（刺）扎了手。

scene.actor: One gardener touches a rose stem and notices its thorn near her hand, without injury.
beats: The gardener reaches for the rose
The thorn touches her hand
She notices the sharp point
scene.ending: A thorn on a rose pricks a gardener's hand without injury.

review.reason: 伸手去碰 rose（玫瑰），被茎上的 thorn（刺）扎到，尖刺就是这样。

cards.sentence: Thursday（星期四）在一个 week（星期）里已接近尾声。

scene.setting: A quiet office late in the workweek
scene.actor: One worker closes a plain notebook as the workweek nears its end.
beats: The week is nearly finished
Thursday arrives
The worker gets close to the weekend
scene.ending: Thursday comes near the end of the week.

review.reason: 一个 week（星期）快到头时先到 Thursday（星期四），再往后就是周末。

cards.sentence: Tuesday（星期二）出现在一个 week（星期）的早些时候。

scene.setting: A quiet classroom early in the week
scene.actor: One student begins a school day at a plain desk.
beats: The week begins
Tuesday arrives
The student starts the day's work
scene.ending: Tuesday comes early in the week.

review.reason: 刚过完周一，一个 week（星期）尚在开头，正是 Tuesday（星期二）。

cards.sentence: 一个 underlying（潜在的）problem（问题）让机器停了下来。

scene.actor: One mechanic opens a plain machine and discovers a hidden loose wire causing it to stop.
beats: The machine stops
The mechanic looks inside
An underlying problem is found
scene.ending: A hidden underlying problem stops the machine.

review.reason: 表面看是停机，真正作祟的是藏在下面的 problem（问题），这就是 underlying（潜在的）。

cards.sentence: 这份 up-to-date（最新的）报告收录了刚发生的 news（消息）。

scene.actor: One reporter checks a fresh plain report beside a radio carrying current news.
beats: New information arrives
The report is updated
The up-to-date report includes the latest news
scene.ending: An up-to-date report includes the latest news.

review.reason: 报告里全是刚发生的 news（消息），内容不过时就是 up-to-date（最新的）。

cards.sentence: bus 刚停稳，站台上的人群就往门口涌，他回头喊了一句跟上，us 几个挤在同一节车厢里，谁也没被落下。

review.reason: us 藏在 bus 里，车来我们一起上。

cards.sentence: vein（静脉）沿着身体，把血液一路送回 heart（心）。

scene.actor: One teacher points to a plain unlabelled model showing veins returning blood toward a heart.
beats: Blood moves through a vessel
The vein carries it toward the heart
The direction of flow is shown
scene.ending: A vein carries blood back toward the heart.

review.reason: 血液往回流的通道是 vein（静脉），终点正是 heart（心）。

cards.sentence: velvet（天鹅绒）是一种绒毛短而密的软 cloth（布）。

scene.actor: One shopkeeper lets a customer feel a plain piece of velvet cloth.
beats: The cloth is unfolded
The customer touches its soft surface
The velvet feels smooth and thick
scene.ending: A customer feels the soft pile of velvet cloth.

review.reason: 摸起来滑软的 cloth（布）就是 velvet（天鹅绒），表面一层密密的短绒。

cards.sentence: 在 table（桌子）边，厨师往沙拉里加了些 vinegar（醋）。

scene.actor: One cook pours a little vinegar over a fresh salad in a plain bowl.
beats: The salad is prepared
The cook adds vinegar
The salad is ready to serve
scene.ending: A cook adds vinegar to a salad at the table.

review.reason: table（桌子）上的调味瓶里那酸味的液体就是 vinegar（醋）。

cards.sentence: 午睡过后，她想轻轻把 child（儿童）waken（唤醒）。

scene.setting: A quiet bedroom after a nap
scene.actor: One parent gently calls to one sleeping child beside the bed.
beats: The child finishes a nap
The parent calls gently
She tries to waken the child
scene.ending: A parent tries to waken a child after a nap.

review.reason: 午睡结束，轻声把 child（儿童）叫醒，waken（唤醒）就是这个动作。

cards.sentence: Wednesday（星期三）正好在一个 week（星期）的中间。

scene.actor: One student studies at a plain desk during the middle of a school week.
beats: The week begins
Several days pass
Wednesday arrives in the middle
scene.ending: Wednesday falls in the middle of the week.

review.reason: 一个 week（星期）走到一半，中间那天就是 Wednesday（星期三）。

cards.sentence: famous 名声在外，well-known 众所周知。

review.reason: well-known 即出名，名声在外人尽知。

cards.sentence: 那个 wicked（邪恶的）thief（贼）偷走了孩子的玩具。

scene.actor: One thief sneaks away with a child's toy while one child watches in surprise.
beats: The child leaves a toy nearby
The thief steals it
The wicked act is revealed
scene.ending: A wicked thief steals a child's toy.

review.reason: thief（贼）偷走孩子的玩具，这种存心作恶就是 wicked（邪恶的）。

cards.sentence: 她朝 friend（朋友）飞快地 wink（眨眼）了一下。

scene.actor: Exactly two friends share a light moment as one gives the other a quick wink.
beats: The friends meet
One friend closes one eye briefly
She gives her friend a wink
scene.ending: One friend gives another a quick wink.

review.reason: 朝 friend（朋友）眨一下眼当作暗号，wink（眨眼）就是单眼一闭一开。

cards.sentence: 这件 work（工作）你们可以 yourselves（你们自己）完成。

scene.actor: Exactly two people complete a small task together without outside help.
beats: The pair starts the task
They work together unaided
They complete the work yourselves
scene.ending: You can complete the work yourselves.

review.reason: 不用别人帮忙，work（工作）由你们自己动手，yourselves（你们自己）就是反身强调。

cards.sentence: road（路）绕着山丘来回拐弯，走成了 zigzag（之字形）。

scene.actor: No people: a winding road bends in sharp alternating turns around a small hill.
beats: The road approaches the hill
It turns sharply one way
It zigzags around the hill
scene.ending: A road makes a zigzag around a hill.

review.reason: road（路）绕着山来回折返，zigzag（之字形）就是这种曲折走法。
